summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration 4 (Admin tabbed restructure + Facilities + Masters + per-disease LTFU + patient-card call/WhatsApp + patient record Demographic + DOB↔Age two-way + encounter facility/visit picker + province scope for Mary). Cleared localStorage 'trias.state.v1' at start. Ran 39 Playwright checks against the public preview URL; all 39 passed. Coverage: admin has exactly 3 top tabs (Users/Facilities/Masters); Users table columns are exactly [User, Role, Province, Data access, Edit, Active, Password] with NO Facility column anywhere in the table or the create-user dialog; scope <select> options are exactly ['Own records only', 'All records in Province', 'All records across the programme']; create-user dialog validates required fields, has photo capture and adds the row; Facilities tab lists the 5 seeded facilities, validates required name+province, cascades Province→District→Village (Madang → Madang District → Bilbil), the newly created 'TEST Facility Alpha' appears in the table and is selectable in the encounter facility picker, and the trash button removes F-005; Masters tab shows Drugs/Symptoms/Visit type/Programme rules/Client & branding, drug count badge shows 14 and grows/shrinks on add/remove, visit-type count shows 6, and Programme rules shows five separate day inputs seeded to scabies=30, yaws=60, buruli=90, lf=180, leprosy=180; setting scabies LTFU to 1 tags multiple patients 'Lost to follow-up' and raising it to 9999 removes those tags (per-disease threshold using patient's most recent disease record); patient cards show tel:+phone and https://wa.me/<digits> icons and clicking them does NOT navigate into the card; patient record shows the action row (Patients / Suspect / New encounter / Call / WhatsApp) on its own line and a full-width Demographic card with the patient photo and Patient ID, DOB, Age, Sex, Weight, Height, Blood group, Phone, Email, Village, District, Province — Facility, Health worker, Pregnancy, Lactating, Household, Treatment end date and Treatment outcome are NOT present; New encounter popup validates missing facility/visit type with a toast, and when both are chosen it opens the encounter whose subtitle shows the chosen facility & visit type, saves and the timeline row shows Follow-up + Bilbil Health Centre; opening /patients/P-2026-001001/encounter/yaws directly shows the blocking visit-context-dialog with Continue-validation and Cancel returning to the patient record; opening ?enc=ENC-000501 does NOT show that dialog and preserves 'Bilbil Health Centre' + 'Initial encounter'; registration DOB=2015-04-10 auto-fills Age=11 and Age=40 auto-fills DOB=1986-…; Mary (scope=province) sees only Madang patients (Elijah, Grace, Peter, Rita) and NOT Lucy Sipa (East Sepik) nor Samuel Bau (Morobe); at 390x844 the /admin page no longer overflows horizontally (documentElement.scrollWidth=390). No console/page runtime errors, but one React hydration warning: `<a>` inside `<a>` on the patient list card (see issues).

console_warnings: React hydration warning on /patients: 'In HTML, <a> cannot be a descendant of <a>.' — the patient-card <Link> (renders an <a>) wraps the tel: and wa.me anchors. Functionally works and stopPropagation prevents card navigation, but this is invalid HTML. Suggest replacing the outer <Link> with a <div onClick={navigate(...)}> or converting the call/WhatsApp anchors to buttons that call window.open(...) inside a handler with e.stopPropagation().

action_items: (LOW) Resolve <a>-inside-<a> hydration warning on Patients list card by making either the card or the tel/wa.me children non-<a> elements.
critical_code_review_comments: Patients.jsx wraps the whole card in a react-router <Link> and puts two <a href> children inside it — React logs a hydration warning. Prefer onClick+navigate on the card and keep call/WhatsApp as <a> children.
store.addUser / addFacility / saveEncounter still generate ids with Date.now()/Math.random() — collision risk on fast clicks; a monotonic counter kept in state would be safer.

store.addFacility uses (facilities.length + 1) padded to 3 digits for the id; deleting F-005 and then adding another one will create a duplicate F-005 (since length is unchanged after add-then-delete, or worse, id collision after a delete-then-add cycle). Use a max(existing numeric suffix)+1 or a counter.
Encounter.jsx has fallback `linkedSuspect = latest suspect for patient` when no ?sus is provided — carried over from iteration 3 comment.
PatientRecord.jsx 'Manage household & contacts' still opens the disease chooser via setChooser(true) instead of routing to a household page — carried over.
Admin.jsx SCOPES object is redeclared per render — fine but consider useMemo or hoist outside the file (already hoisted actually, good).

Encounter.jsx `askVisit` is initialized once from URL params; if the user opens the disease chooser then navigates without params the visit-context dialog would appear, which is the intended behaviour.
test_credentials: admin@trias.health / Admin@123, joseph@trias.health / Health@123, mary@trias.health / Health@123. localStorage key 'trias.state.v1' must be cleared before each fresh run.
seed_data_creation: None — used seeded USERS, PATIENTS, ENCOUNTERS, FACILITIES_LIST (5), DRUGS (14), VISIT_TYPES (6), DEFAULT_LTFU. Created and then removed 'TEST Facility Alpha', 'TEST Drug Z' and 'TEST Visit Type' during the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SelectField from /app/frontend/src/components/Fields.jsx puts data-testid={testid} on the SelectTrigger directly (NO -trigger suffix) and data-testid={testid}-opt-{value} on each SelectItem. Add ~200ms wait between opening a Select inside a Dialog and clicking an option, and always use force=True for the option click (dialog overlay intercepts). SectionCard around the Users table now uses min-w-0 in its grid column — the 390px overflow is fixed. The Encounter page's askVisit dialog auto-opens whenever the URL has neither ?fac nor ?vt AND there is no ?enc — the Cancel button navigates back to /patients/:id and Continue validates both fields. New-encounter timeline row picks up visit type via `type: encVisit || existing?.type` and facility via `facility: encFacility || p.facility`. State shape adds state.facilities[], state.settings.drugs[], state.settings.visitTypes[], state.settings.ltfuByDisease{}. innerText returns CSS-transformed text (uppercase labels come out uppercase) — use case-insensitive matching for label assertions.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found this round. Only observation: <a>-inside-<a> hydration warning on the Patients list card (Link wraps two child anchors).
